result.title: RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop
result.summary: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RoboBuilder 基准，让 coding agent 用标准零件、电机和 3D 打印件协同设计机器人硬件与程序，仿真通过后实物搭建并在真实赛道测试，并利用真实运行视频反馈闭环修正设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线关联较弱，但其「主动请求测量并用真实视频校准模拟器、据失败证据重设计」的闭环，可能为视觉证据筛选、内部状态更新及获取与停止决策提供评价线索，值得核查。
